title: Trollface Trial Chamber Vaults
description: This resource pack replaces regular trial vaults with the classic Trollface meme. The ominous vault version features a Trollface holding a mango.
body:
This lighthearted meme resource pack completely overhauls the trial chambers loot system by injecting classic internet humor into your world. It is fully compatible with Minecraft 1.21 and newer versions without requiring any external modifications.

The resource pack replaces regular trial vaults with the iconic grinning **Trollface** meme. The ominous trial vault version features a cursed Trollface holding a mango. Additionally, the generic sound effect for ejecting items from both vaults is now replaced with a funny mango meme sound.
